examples.en: My mom braided my hair.
I wear my hair in a long braid.
Braiding your hair is cool and comfortable.
My little sister is braiding the doll's hair.

examples.ko: 끈 세 가닥을 땋아서 팔찌를 만들었어요.
examples.en: I braided three strings to make a bracelet.
I will braid my hair into two plaits.

explain: 머리카락이나 끈을 보통 세 가닥으로 엇갈리게 엮을 때 써요. 'ㅎ' 받침이라 발음이 [따타], '땋아요'로 활용해요. 머리를 묶는 '묶다'와는 달라서 엮는 모양이 생겨야 땋다예요.
explain_en: You use it for weaving hair or cord in an interlaced way, typically with three strands. The ㅎ final makes it sound like [따타], and the polite form is 땋아요. It differs from 묶다 (to tie); 땋다 requires the woven pattern.

examples.en: I put red nail polish on my nails.
My nail polish is chipped, so I have to redo it.

examples.ko: 주말에 친구와 같이 매니큐어를 사러 갔어요.
examples.en: On the weekend I went with a friend to buy nail polish.
This nail polish dries quickly, so it's convenient.
You can't wear nail polish at school.

examples.ko: 매니큐어 냄새가 너무 독해서 창문을 열었어요.
examples.en: The nail polish smell was so strong that I opened the window.

explain: 한국어 '매니큐어'는 손톱에 칠하는 물감 자체를 가리켜요. 발톱에 하는 것은 '페디큐어'라고 하고, 동사는 '바르다'나 '칠하다'를 써요. 일상 대화에서는 '네일'이라는 말도 많이 들려요.
explain_en: In Korean '매니큐어' means the nail polish itself. For toenails people say '페디큐어', and the verbs are '바르다' or '칠하다'. In daily talk you also hear the word '네일'.

examples.en: If you press the cartilage in your ear, it feels soft.

examples.ko: 코는 물렁뼈로 되어 있어서 잘 구부러져요.
examples.en: The nose is made of cartilage, so it bends easily.
I ordered fried chicken cartilage.
My knee cartilage wore down, so I went to the hospital.
Cartilage is softer than hard bone.
The doctor checked the condition of the cartilage.

explain: 병원이나 수업에서는 같은 뜻의 '연골'이라는 말도 많이 써요. '물렁뼈'는 닭 연골 요리 같은 음식 이야기나 일상 대화에서도 자주 나와요.
explain_en: At hospitals and in classes the same thing is also called '연골'. '물렁뼈' also comes up in daily conversation and food talk, such as chicken cartilage dishes.

examples.en: I got a mosquito bite, so I put liquid pain reliever on it.
It stings if the liquid pain reliever gets in your eyes.
Liquid pain reliever feels cool when you apply it.
I bought a bottle of liquid pain reliever at the pharmacy.
There is also liquid pain reliever in Mom's drawer.
I rubbed the insect bite with liquid pain reliever.

explain: 붙이는 '파스'와 달리 액체를 발라서 쓰는 약이에요. 어깨가 뻐근할 때나 벌레 물린 곳에 쓰는 경우가 많아요.
explain_en: Unlike the adhesive '파스' patch, this is a liquid you rub on. People often use it for stiff shoulders or insect bites.

examples.ko: 이 크림은 미백 효과가 있다고 해요.
examples.en: They say this cream has a whitening effect.
I am looking for a product whose purpose is whitening.
I booked the dentist for teeth whitening.

examples.ko: 미백 기능이 있는 화장품은 자외선 차단도 중요해요.
examples.en: For cosmetics with a whitening function, sun protection matters too.

examples.ko: 미백에 좋다는 과일 주스를 마셔 봤어요.
examples.en: I tried a fruit juice said to be good for whitening.

examples.ko: 미백 관리는 꾸준히 하는 게 중요해요.
examples.en: It is important to keep up whitening care steadily.

explain: 광고와 제품 이름에 자주 나오는 말이에요. '미백 크림', '치아 미백'처럼 명사로 붙여 쓰고, 일상 대화에서는 '하얘지다', '하얗게 하다'를 더 많이 써요. 피부와 치아에 쓰는 말이라 옷이나 벽에는 쓰지 않아요.
explain_en: It appears often in ads and product names. It attaches as a noun, like 미백 크림 and 치아 미백, while everyday talk uses 하얘지다 or 하얗게 하다. It is for skin and teeth, so it is not used for clothes or walls.

examples.en: I have a lot of dandruff, so I changed my shampoo.

examples.ko: 비듬 때문에 검은 옷을 입기가 불편해요.
examples.en: Because of dandruff, wearing black clothes is uncomfortable.

examples.ko: 겨울에는 두피가 건조해서 비듬을 더 신경 써요.
examples.en: In winter my scalp is dry, so I pay more attention to dandruff.

examples.ko: 비듬은 자주 감아도 없어지지 않을 때가 있어요.
examples.en: Sometimes dandruff does not go away even if you wash often.
Please recommend a shampoo that is good for dandruff.
I was embarrassed because even white dandruff was visible on my shoulders.

explain: 머리 피부에서 하얗게 떨어지는 것을 말하고, '비듬이 생기다', '비듬이 떨어지다'처럼 자주 말해요. 약국이나 마트에서는 '비듬 샴푸'라는 말도 볼 수 있어요.
explain_en: It refers to the white flakes that come off the scalp, and it is often used as '비듬이 생기다' or '비듬이 떨어지다'. At pharmacies and stores you may also see '비듬 샴푸'.

examples.en: I had a headache, so I took an aspirin.

examples.ko: 이 약은 아스피린이 아니라 다른 약이에요.
examples.en: This medicine is not aspirin but a different one.
I bought a bottle of aspirin at the pharmacy.
There is aspirin in my backpack, but no bandage.
The first aid kit has aspirin in it too.
Some people are allergic to aspirin.

explain: '진통제'는 아픔을 줄이는 약을 두루 부르는 이름이고, 아스피린은 그중 하나의 약 이름이에요. 약은 '먹다'와 같이 쓰고, 어른께는 '드시다'라고 해요. 병원에서 받는 약은 '처방약'이라고 해요.
explain_en: '진통제' is the general name for medicine that reduces pain, and 아스피린 is one specific medicine among them. Medicine goes with '먹다', and for an elder you say '드시다'. Medicine from a hospital prescription is '처방약'.

examples.en: I had a formal outfit made to wear to the wedding.
Soldiers wear dress uniforms at ceremonies.

examples.ko: 예복은 평소 옷보다 단정하고 격식이 있어요.
examples.en: Formal wear is neater and more formal than everyday clothes.
I only wear this formal outfit at graduations.

examples.ko: 예복 때문에 너무 더워서 땀이 났어요.
examples.en: The formal clothes made me so hot that I sweated.
What is the difference between a suit and formal wear?

explain: 예복은 결혼식, 졸업식, 공식 행사처럼 격식 있는 자리에서 입는 옷이에요. '정장'은 직장에서도 입지만 예복은 특별한 행사 때 입어서 더 무거운 느낌이에요. 신부가 입는 옷은 '웨딩드레스', 신랑이 입는 옷은 '턱시도'나 '예복'이라고 해요.
explain_en: 예복 is clothing for formal occasions such as weddings, graduations and official events. A '정장' (suit) can be worn to work too, but 예복 is for special events, so it feels heavier. A bride's outfit is a '웨딩드레스', and a groom's is a '턱시도' or '예복'.

examples.en: The stain is removed cleanly.
Ads were removed from the app.

examples.ko: 제거된 파일은 다시 볼 수 없어요.
examples.en: Removed files cannot be seen again.
I wait until the danger is removed.
Harmful germs are being eliminated.
The problem was eliminated, so I feel at ease.

explain: 더럽거나 위험하거나 필요 없는 것이 없어질 때 써요. '없어지다'보다 방법이 있어서 사라졌다는 느낌이 있어요. 짝말은 '제거하다'와 '추가되다'예요.
explain_en: Used when something dirty, dangerous or unneeded disappears. It suggests removal by some method, more than simply vanishing. Related words are the active verb and the passive of adding.

examples.en: After the surgery, my grandfather is in the intensive care unit.

examples.ko: 중환자실에는 가족도 마음대로 들어갈 수 없어요.
examples.en: Even family cannot enter the ICU freely.
He was badly hurt in a traffic accident and moved to the ICU.
The nurse stayed in the ICU all night.
Fortunately, he came out of the ICU two days later.

examples.ko: 드라마 속 중환자실 장면을 보고 눈물이 났어요.
examples.en: I cried watching the ICU scene in the drama.

explain: '중환자실로 옮기다', '중환자실에 들어가다'처럼 쓰면 자연스러워요. 일반 병실은 '병실'이고, 아주 급한 환자가 가는 응급 진료 공간은 '응급실'이라서 서로 달라요. 'ICU'라는 영어 이름도 병원에서 같이 써요.
explain_en: 중환자실로 옮기다 and 중환자실에 들어가다 sound natural. An ordinary room is a 병실, and the place for urgent emergency care is the 응급실, so they are different. Hospitals also use the English name ICU.

en: to apply a hot pack; to apply a cold pack

examples.ko: 목욕탕에서 한 시간 동안 찜질을 했어요.
examples.en: I spent an hour doing a hot compress at the bathhouse.

examples.ko: 허리가 아플 때는 따뜻하게 찜질하면 도움이 돼요.
examples.en: When your back hurts, a warm compress helps.

examples.ko: 뭉친 근육이 풀리게 뜨거운 물수건으로 찜질했어요.
examples.en: I used a hot wet towel as a compress to loosen the tight muscle.
Please put an ice pack on the bruise.
My shoulder was stiff, so I used a hot pack and went to sleep.

examples.ko: 찜질하는 동안 책을 읽으면 시간이 빨리 가요.
examples.en: If you read a book while using a compress, time passes quickly.

explain: 뜨거운 것을 대면 '온찜질', 차가운 것을 대면 '냉찜질'이에요. '찜질을 하다'로도 자주 말하고, 한국식 사우나 시설은 '찜질방'이라고 해요.
explain_en: Applying something hot is '온찜질' and applying something cold is '냉찜질'. People often say it as '찜질을 하다', and the Korean-style sauna facility is called a '찜질방'.

examples.en: My younger sister knitted a scarf with wool yarn.
Grandmother is knitting with wool yarn.

examples.ko: 문구점에서 빨간 털실을 두 뭉치 샀어요.
examples.en: I bought two balls of red yarn at the stationery store.
The cat is playing with a ball of yarn.
The yarn is tangled, and it's really hard to untangle.
My head feels warm when I wear a yarn hat.

explain: 뜨개질에 쓰는 양털 같은 실이고, 보통 '털실로 짜다/뜨다'처럼 말해요. 실 한 덩어리는 '뭉치'나 '타래'로 세어요. 일상에서는 그냥 '실'이라고 하기도 하지만 털로 만든 실은 '털실'이라고 해야 정확해요.
explain_en: This is wool-like yarn used for knitting, and people say '털실로 짜다/뜨다'. One lump of it is counted as a '뭉치' or '타래'. In daily talk people may just say '실', but yarn made of wool is precisely '털실'.
